title: Sprout

stage.name: Sprout
stage.description: A shoot rises toward the light and the first leaves open.

intro: Now the growth starts to show.

questions.prompt: Which way does the shoot grow?
questions.why: Shoots grow away from gravity and toward light.

questions.prompt: Put a sprout's first days in order.
items: The root anchors in the soil
The shoot pushes up through the soil
The stem straightens toward the light
questions.why: The root anchors first, then the shoot climbs and opens its leaves in the light.

questions.prompt: Many seedlings push up bent like a hook to protect their tender tip.
questions.why: The hook pulls the delicate tip up through the soil instead of pushing it.

questions.prompt: Your relationship is starting to show, and a friend asks about it. What's a healthy approach?
options: Share what you're both comfortable sharing
Keep it secret from everyone indefinitely
Ask your friends to decide whether it's right
questions.why: Agreeing together on what to share respects you both, and lets the people who care about you be part of it.

talk: Who would you most like each other to meet, and why?
